responsibility: Defines the ia64-linux subtarget configuration layered on top of the generic IA-64 and GNU/Linux support. It sets Linux preprocessor builtins, startfile/endfile and dynamic-linker specs, profiling-driver behavior, EH-linking defaults, stack-check support, and Linux-specific libfunc initialization so the backend integrates with glibc, PIE/shared linking, and the Linux runtime ABI on IA-64.
